title: MobBuckets Resources
description: Resourcepack for server owners wanting to use MobBuckets on their server so nobody else has to download the mod. Distribute this to your playerbase and prevent mod conflictions!
body:
## What is this?
This resourcepack is a second option for [MobBuckets](https://modrinth.com/plugin/mobbuckets) if player's would rather just use a resourcepack than install a client side mod specifically to play with textures on a server using MobBuckets.

## What is included in the resourcepack:
- **MobBuckets custom namespace models** for the "Bucket of Player" and "Bucket of mob" which are both used by the [plugin](https://modrinth.com/plugin/mobbuckets/version/1.0.0) and [mod](https://modrinth.com/plugin/mobbuckets/version/Jq1MdhfI).

## How can I test the models without downloading the mod?

### PlayerBucket:
```
/give @a bucket[item_model="mobbuckets:player"]
```
### MobBucket:

```
/give @a bucket[item_model="mobbuckets:generic"]
```
